notes: WArmy 0.4.35 — fix: right-clicking a second-column session icon could probabilistically show two overlapping context menus. Root cause: when text was selected anywhere (e.g. in the chat area), the document-level generic copy menu (#youJianCaiDan) also fired on the row right-click because session rows lacked the data-has-ctx yield marker and did not stop propagation, so it opened alongside the row menu. Fix: session rows now carry data-has-ctx and stop propagation; closeContextMenu removes ALL same-id menus (querySelectorAll, not just the first) and also hides the generic menu; the generic show() closes any row menu first (mutual exclusion). Verified with a real-device probe (positive: single menu across selected-text / rapid-right-click / no-selection / dismiss scenarios; negative control: reverting the fix reproduces the overlap). Changed-area gates passed three consecutive clean rounds. Carries all prior features unchanged.
